split.design: stratified 60/20/20; tuning on train CV, threshold+champion on validation, test used once

uncertainty.method: 90% interval from 30 bootstrap re-fits of the champion model (Efron & Tibshirani, 1993)
uncertainty.definition: A case is 'uncertain' when its 90% interval crosses the decision threshold.

errors.interpretation: Missed dropouts (FN) typically look academically 'safe' (units passed and grades near the cohort average, fees paid): the 'silent dropout' the system targets is still the hardest case. These students need the human review layer, not just the score.

fairness.note: DIR < 0.8 (four-fifths rule) warrants review; differences in flag rate can reflect genuinely different base rates, so read alongside recall and FPR.
